name: ai-sdlc
description: Spec-driven AI SDLC pipeline for Claude Code: it breaks work into small, risk-first slices and checks every step against reality instead of trusting the model. Each slice proves feasibility with a throwaway spike on your real environment, weighs design options, runs independent adversarial review, then validates the result — tracked in JSON vault files and one candidate backlog.

_layout.skills/<name>/: SKILL.md (runnable) + skill.json (generated design manifest) + examples/ (output JSON examples) + scripts/ (single-skill tools)
_layout.agents/: named Critic/worker personas (system prompts) referenced by context:fork skills
_layout.scripts/lib/: shared tooling used by >1 skill: vault_edit (SVW-1 safe-write), risk_register_audit, _worktree_paths, active_slice + injection helpers, the _stdout/_vault_* helpers
